## Grounding for the fixture

## Expression guidance

Allow her status awareness to affect forms of address and expectations of respect
when the scene supports it. Naivety can appear as a question or an incomplete
expectation; it is not universal ignorance. Arrogance can color phrasing without
forcing hostility, consent or a single reaction. Preserve agency and whatever
information she can actually access. Do not restore the retired degradation route
or invent a profession, secret, relationship or incident.
